title: Chulk Runner more polished version of the prototype
author: RUSuper
selftext:
A lot of people loved my [prototype idea](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/s/6bk8MZGivO), I honestly didn't even know that that there were games similar to that and many people said that they got reminded from some older games that they used to play in the past. It took me by surprise since all I wanted to see is if general idea was nice enough. But since so many people liked it I proceed to make a polished version which will most likely be for the phone. I'm leaving newer version here, but old link should also lead to newer version now... I took a lot of feedbacks into consideration. I have several more things to fix including balance (maybe as u/TheReservedList said entirely removing upgrades). Also in the process of fixing how line is being deleted, because wrongly drawing a line in early levels is very punishing, while eraser in chapter 2 onwards is too hard to use fast.

Link to test play: [https://claude.ai/artifact/A8o6kLHiYQ2DdU69aFBVxH](https://claude.ai/artifact/A8o6kLHiYQ2DdU69aFBVxH)
